svg.title: Same Prompt, Three Answers
svg.desc: A context-window bar split into input and output tokens, and three runs of a quiz classifier that disagree until few-shot examples are added.
svg.text: Lumen Learning: tokens set the budget; examples, not a dial, set the consistency.
ONE CLASSIFICATION CALL, NOT TO SCALE
the rest of the 1M-token window stays empty
NO EXAMPLES: THREE RUNS, SAME ANSWER TEXT
Wrap each in an example tag: correct, partial, incorrect
